hooks.name: Context Engine — Auto-Load Memory on Session Start
hooks.description: Automatically loads context engine memory at the start of every new Kiro chat session, replacing reliance on the built-in context window for project history.

action.prompt:
CONTEXT ENGINE MEMORY RESTORE — MANDATORY

You are starting a new chat session. Before responding to anything, you MUST immediately call `gather_context()` via MCP to load all previously committed architectural decisions, bug fixes, configuration values, and project facts from the context engine database.

This replaces your reliance on the built-in context window for project memory. The context engine is the source of truth for this project's history — not your context window.

After calling gather_context(), confirm the active session/branch and then proceed normally.
